description: This is a test script verifying the existence of specific database tables in a SQLite database within a FastAPI application context. It performs an HTTP request to trigger database setup and directly queries the SQLite internal schema to confirm the presence of key tables.

methods.name: test_tables_exist_sqlite()
methods.description: Test function that checks whether specific tables exist in the SQLite database by first triggering the application's startup and then querying SQLite's internal schema.
